subtitle: The last Hoysala king between Delhi’s shadow and Vijayanagara’s dawn

panels.shot: epic wide shot at dusk, half-ruined Hoysala temple against a gathering southern army
panels.action: Veera Ballala III stands in worn royal armour before a Hoysala temple, the sky split between northern storm clouds and a glowing southern horizon.

dialogue.text: In an age of raids and ruined capitals, Veera Ballala III, last great Hoysala, fights on—between Delhi’s reach and the uncertain dawn that will become Vijayanagara.

i18n.hi: लुटेरे दौर और उजड़ी राजधानियों में वीर बल्लाल तृतीय, आखिरी महान होयसला, लड़ता रहा—दिल्ली की पहुंच और उस अनिश्चित सुबह के बीच जो आगे चलकर विजयनगर बनी।

panels.shot: slow push-in from bird’s-eye over Dorasamudra to close on Ballala’s thoughtful face
panels.action: The camera sinks from a carved mandapa roof over Dorasamudra’s dense temples to Veera Ballala III seated in council, brow furrowed, listening to reports.

dialogue.text: When Veera Ballala III took the Hoysala throne in the late thirteenth century, his capital Dorasamudra shone, but the world around it had turned sharp and uncertain.

i18n.hi: तेरहवीं सदी के अंत में जब वीर बल्लाल तृतीय ने होयसला सिंहासन संभाला, तो दोरसमुद्र चमकता था, पर उसके चारों तरफ की दुनिया नुकीली और अनिश्चित हो चुकी थी।

panels.shot: medium interior council shot with map on floor, low-angle to show pressure on Ballala
panels.action: Ballala kneels beside a floor map marked with miniature standards—Yadava to the north, Pandya to the south, and a looming symbol for Delhi in the far distance.

dialogue.text: Yadava kings pressed from Devagiri, Pandyas fought in the deep south, and a new northern power—the Delhi Sultanate—began sending steel and demands toward the peninsula.

i18n.hi: देवगिरी से यादव राजा चढ़ते थे, गहरे दक्षिण में पांड्य लड़ते थे, और उत्तर में नई ताकत—दिल्ली सल्तनत—इस प्रायद्वीप पर तलवार और फरमान भेजने लगी थी।

panels.shot: close-up on Ballala’s hand placing tribute on a tray, with distant horsemen silhouettes
panels.action: Ballala’s strong but reluctant hand rests on a tray of coins and jewels, while through an open arch distant cavalry banners flutter, hinting at Delhi’s reach.

dialogue.text: Like many southern rulers, Ballala bargained for time—sending tribute north, watching each demand, weighing how long gold could keep iron at bay.

i18n.hi: दूसरे दक्षिणी शासकों की तरह बल्लाल ने वक़्त खरीदा—उत्तर को नज़राना भेजकर, हर मांग तौलकर, सोचते हुए कि कब तक सोना लोहे को दूर रख सकता है।

panels.shot: wide shot of Dorasamudra streets with artisans and soldiers, atmosphere tense
panels.action: Within Dorasamudra, sculptors chip stone panels, merchants hurry by, and soldiers drill in the courtyards, all under a heavy sky thick with dust and expectation.

dialogue.text: Yet inscriptions show a kingdom still working—fields taxed, temples endowed, armies kept in motion. Tribute was not surrender. It was a pause.

i18n.hi: फिर भी शिलालेख बताते हैं कि राज्य चलते रहा—खेतों पर कर, मंदिरों को दान, सेनाएँ चलती रहीं। नज़राना आत्मसमर्पण नहीं था, बस ठहराव था।

panels.shot: dramatic low-angle of a Delhi army crest appearing over a hill, Ballala in foreground
panels.action: At a hilltop near Dorasamudra, Ballala looks out from behind parapets as distant horsemen crest the horizon, banners of the Khalji Sultanate stark against the sky.

dialogue.text: The pause shattered around 1311, when Alauddin Khalji’s forces came south in force. Amir Khusrau names Dorasamudra among the cities reached by that campaign.

i18n.hi: यह ठहराव १३११ के आसपास टूट गया, जब अलाउद्दीन खिलजी की फौजें पूरे जोर से दक्षिण आईं। अमीर ख़ुसरो उस मुहिम में पहुँचे शहरों में दोरसमुद्र का भी नाम लेते हैं।

panels.shot: somber interior shot, Ballala walking past darkened temple halls, no explicit battle
panels.action: Ballala moves through a shadowed temple corridor, pillars looming, as outside the faint silhouettes of foreign horsemen can be seen passing through the city streets.

dialogue.text: The chronicler praises looted wealth and humbled kings. In Hoysala lands, later records speak more softly of disruption, tribute, and a capital that would not stay secure.

i18n.hi: इतिहासकार लूटी दौलत और झुकाए गए राजाओं की तारीफ़ करता है। होयसला इलाके में बाद के लेख disruption, नज़राना और अस्थिर राजधानी की बात को धीमे सुर में लिखते हैं।

panels.shot: medium shot of Ballala mounting a horse at dawn, with a small retinue, city behind
panels.action: At pale dawn outside Dorasamudra’s walls, Ballala mounts his horse with a lean escort; behind him the temple towers fade into mist, already more memory than refuge.

dialogue.text: Ballala did not vanish with Dorasamudra’s eclipse. He shifted. From inscriptions we see him move his weight south and east, looking for new ground to stand on.

i18n.hi: दोरसमुद्र के ढलने के साथ बल्लाल गायब नहीं हुआ। वह करवट बदला। शिलालेखों से दिखता है कि उसने अपना भार दक्षिण और पूरब की ओर डाला, नए सहारे ढूंढते हुए।

panels.shot: wide shot of Tiruvannamalai hill temple, Ballala’s camp in the foreground
panels.action: The hill of Tiruvannamalai rises with its temple gopuram, while Ballala’s tents and standards dot the plain below, merging northern armour with a Tamil landscape.

dialogue.text: In Tamil country, near Tiruvannamalai and other strong points, Hoysala epigraphs place Ballala as a power among Pandyas and new Sultanate claimants, fighting for southern space.

i18n.hi: तमिल देश में, तिरुवन्नामलाई और दूसरे क़िलों के आसपास, होयसला लेख बल्लाल को पांड्यों और नई सल्तनती दावेदारियों के बीच एक ताकत के रूप में दिखाते हैं, दक्षिण की जगह के लिए लड़ते हुए।

panels.shot: close interior council shot with Tamil chieftains, wary faces lit by lamplight
panels.action: Within a Tamil courtyard lit by oil lamps, Ballala sits with local chiefs, palm-leaf documents spread between them, each man’s face wary but intent.

dialogue.text: “North or south, we all bleed when others choose our masters,” Ballala says quietly.

i18n.hi: "उत्तर हो या दक्षिण, दूसरों के मालिक चुनने पर ख़ून तो हमारा ही बहता है," बल्लाल धीमे कहता है।

panels.shot: medium shot of Ballala in armour before Tiruvannamalai temple, readying for march
panels.action: Ballala stands fully armoured beneath Tiruvannamalai’s towering gopuram, tightening his gauntlet strap as lines of mixed Hoysala and Tamil soldiers form behind him.

dialogue.text: From these bases, he struck at rivals and resisted the new Madurai Sultanate, a breakaway power that made war not only with Delhi but with older temple-centred orders.

i18n.hi: इन ठिकानों से उसने दुश्मनों पर वार किया और नई मदुरै सल्तनत का सामना किया—एक अलग-थलग ताकत जो सिर्फ दिल्ली ही नहीं, पुराने मंदिर-केन्द्रित राजों से भी लड़ती थी।

panels.shot: wide shot of Tungabhadra river bend with fortified town in distance
panels.action: At the Tungabhadra’s stony bend, a fortified town rises with walls and watchtowers, Ballala’s banner flying over its gate as the river glitters in afternoon light.

dialogue.text: Far to the northwest, inscriptions speak of Hosapattana on the Tungabhadra, where Ballala sought another anchor. Some later scholars link it to Vijayanagara’s site, but evidence is debated.

i18n.hi: बहुत उत्तर-पश्चिम में शिलालेख तुंगभद्रा के किनारे होसपट्टन का ज़िक्र करते हैं, जहाँ बल्लाल ने एक और सहारा खोजा। कुछ बाद के विद्वान इसे विजयनगर की जगह से जोड़ते हैं, पर सबूत पर मतभेद है।

panels.shot: close-up on Ballala’s face, half-lit, looking from temple sculpture to river fortress
panels.action: Ballala stands between a delicate Hoysala temple wall and a rough river fortress parapet, turning his gaze from carved dancers to stark battlements.

dialogue.text: We can see not a single founding moment, but a political landscape shifting—Hoysala fortresses, river crossings, camps and courts that would later feed Vijayanagara’s rise.

i18n.hi: यहाँ हमें कोई एक स्थापना-क्षण नहीं दिखता, बल्कि बदलती सियासी ज़मीन—होयसला किले, नदी-पार, डेरा और दरबार, जो आगे चलकर विजयनगर को सहारा देंगे।

panels.shot: medium shot of aging Ballala in field tent, map lit by flickering lamp
panels.action: An older Ballala bends over a map in a canvas tent, armour at his side, lamp flickering as rain hammers the fabric and distant thunder rolls.

dialogue.text: By the 1340s, age weighed on Ballala, but he kept campaigning against Madurai. Ziauddin Barani notes southern struggles as Delhi itself shifted from Khalji to Tughluq rule.

i18n.hi: १३४० के दशक तक उम्र बल्लाल पर भारी थी, पर वह मदुरै के खिलाफ मुहिम जारी रखे रहा। जियाउद्दीन बरनी दक्षिण की टकराहटों का ज़िक्र करता है, उसी वक़्त दिल्ली खुद खिलजी से तुग़लक हुकूमत में बदल रही थी।

panels.shot: low-angle battlefield wide, armies facing off under heavy clouds, no direct combat
panels.action: Two forces stand tense on a plain—Ballala’s weathered standard facing the crescent banners of the Madurai Sultanate—under a low sky ready to break.

dialogue.text: Later accounts and inscriptions agree: around 1342–43, in conflict with Madurai, Veera Ballala III was defeated and killed. The last strong Hoysala king fell far from Dorasamudra.

i18n.hi: बाद की कथाएँ और शिलालेख मिलते हैं: १३४२–४३ के आसपास मदुरै से टकराव में वीर बल्लाल तृतीय हारकर मारा गया। आखिरी मजबूत होयसला राजा दोरसमुद्र से बहुत दूर गिरा।

panels.shot: somber medium shot of Ballala’s empty armour and fallen banner in camp at dusk
panels.action: Ballala’s armour rests empty on a wooden stand, his banner lowered and folded nearby, while campfires burn small and quiet in the gathering dusk.

dialogue.text: His line flickered. Hoysala authority splintered, and different powers—among them the future founders of Vijayanagara—moved into spaces he had fought to hold.

i18n.hi: उसकी वंश-रेखा झिलमिलाकर बुझ गई। होयसला सत्ता बिखर गई, और अलग-अलग ताकतें—जिनमें आगे चलकर विजयनगर के संस्थापक भी थे—उन जगहों में उतर आईं जिन्हें वह बचाए रखना चाहता था।

panels.shot: wide shot of early Vijayanagara-like hilltop city, Hoysala temple ruins in foreground
panels.action: From ruined Hoysala shrines near the river, the view stretches to a later hilltop city with rising gopurams and stone streets, the Tungabhadra curling between.

dialogue.text: Modern historians warn us: there is no simple line from Ballala’s camp to Vijayanagara’s throne. Instead, his world of forts, taxes and alliances shaped the field others would play on.

i18n.hi: आधुनिक इतिहासकार चेतावनी देते हैं: बल्लाल के शिविर से विजयनगर की गद्दी तक कोई सीधी रेखा नहीं है। बल्कि उसके किलों, करों और गठबंधनों की दुनिया ने वह मैदान बनाया जिस पर दूसरों ने खेला।

panels.shot: gentle close-up of temple sculpture of a kingly figure, moss and time on the stone
panels.action: A worn Hoysala sculpture of a regal figure stands on a temple wall, its fine details softened by moss and centuries, yet the stance still proud.

dialogue.text: In stone records and old Tamil and Kannada lands, Ballala remains the king who would not accept that the south belonged to someone else—even as capitals fell around him.

i18n.hi: पत्थर के लेखों में, पुरानी तमिल और कन्नड़ धरती पर बल्लाल वही राजा बना रहता है जो यह मानने को तैयार नहीं था कि दक्षिण किसी और की मिल्कियत है—चाहे उसके आस-पास राजधानियाँ गिरती रहीं।

panels.shot: final wide shot blending Dorasamudra ruins, Tiruvannamalai hill, and Tungabhadra bend
panels.action: The frame layers Dorasamudra’s broken temples, Tiruvannamalai’s hill shrine, and the Tungabhadra river fortress in a single sweeping panorama under a calm sky.

dialogue.text: Veera Ballala III lost his crown but not his place in history—showing that resilience sometimes survives as a landscape of resistance, shaping what comes next long after its maker is gone.

i18n.hi: वीर बल्लाल तृतीय ने ताज खोया, इतिहास में जगह नहीं—दिखाते हुए कि कुछ मज़बूती ज़िद्दी धरती बनकर बचती है, जो अपने रचयिता के जाने के बहुत बाद तक आने वाली दुनिया को गढ़ती रहती है।

title_i18n.hi: बल्लाल तृतीय की दक्षिण पर पकड़

subtitle_i18n.en: The last Hoysala king between Delhi’s shadow and Vijayanagara’s dawn
subtitle_i18n.hi: दिल्ली की परछाईं और विजयनगर की सुबह के बीच आखिरी होयसला राजा
